newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian bandits haul away bank safe with tank.
newsitem.headline: Albanian bandits haul away bank safe with tank.

text.p: Bandits smashed a tank into the Albanian state savings bank in this southern town on Friday and then dragged away the safe, witnesses said.

Lawlessness has swept Albania for two weeks as rebels seized scores of towns and villages, demanding President Sali Berisha quit. The violence has spawned numerous armed gangs who have terrorised the countryside.

The bold robbery at the Banka E Kursimeve by the Gjirokaster bandits enraged residents. An emergency meeting was being held by the mayor, rebel leaders and local gang bosses to try to set up some sort of police force.

Army, police and security forces fled their posts during the popular uprising against Berisha. Thousands of people looted state arsenals and are now heavily armed. They also captured tanks and artillery pieces.
